source: Built SPA, local intercepted fixtures, no production traffic
checks: Pointer Done commits a dirty trimmed name before replacing inputs; reload retains it; Escape remains cancelled after tapping another input
Deleting middle and final rows preserves exact identities and focuses next then previous surviving input
Pointer deletion of a different row retains active dirty input and delays its commit until ordinary blur
Pointer recent promotion while renaming commits first name, preserves both entries and focuses new saved input
Duplicate display names retain separate destination coordinates when selected
320px and 640px at 200% CSS zoom preserve readable controls and horizontal reflow
